in_sanskrit.name: Janvi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of wisdom and knowledge
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Janvi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Janvi is derived from the Sanskrit language, where 'Jan' means wisdom and 'vi' means knowledge. This name is associated with the Hindu goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. The name Janvi signifies a girl who is wise, intelligent, and knowledgeable.
